Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

While we welcome the stability of a 24-month contract, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms to support a price reduction. messages.subject: Fastener kit bundle: request for an authorized pricing review
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for the revised offer. The bundle moves all four kit parts to you. Today you supply only part of one of them, so this is substantial new business for your idle second-shift capacity. Your scorecard sc:70610@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 88.6%, which we would need to see improve as a sole kit supplier.

We offer a 36-month term, so please consider the attached packages. As the change exceeds your account manager's 2% approval limit, could you please put them to your pricing committee for an authorized review?

Could you also tell us whether cheaper equivalent variants or a consolidated kit packaging would lower your cost?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Fastener kit bundle: request for an authorized pricing review
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
Here is the background.
Following an internal review of your proposal and the delivery data provided, we can offer a revised price of €5.45 per unit for a 36-month term with 60-day payment.
We are fully committed to ensuring excellent delivery performance for this consolidated business.
Our technical team will follow up with you directly regarding your questions on equivalent variants and kit packaging.
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.31 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.12 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.07 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.
Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 5 days. With overtime we can deliver in 5 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Fastener kit bundle - packages for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for the revised offer and for sharing your cost calculation. The bundle consolidates all four kit parts with you for a full 36-month term, which fills capacity your second shift has held idle since spring.

The attached packages give you a choice of payment terms, including your preferred shorter terms. We would ask your pricing committee to review them, as they exceed the account manager's approval limit.

Could you also send the full calculation for the cheaper material grade and the wider tolerance? Our engineering team would then check whether those variants are acceptable for the kit. What is the earliest date you could start the first kit deliveries?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Fastener kit bundle - packages for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear customer,

It is always a pleasure working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we truly value our ongoing business relationship. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

For our main quote, we offer a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. We also have an alternative package available: a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months. We appreciate the option for 30-day payment terms, which allows us to reduce our price to €5.38 per unit for the 36-month contract.

Regarding your technical inquiries, as a matter of policy, we do not share detailed internal cost calculations, but our engineering team will gladly assist yours in evaluating the variants. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We can schedule the first kit deliveries to begin four weeks after the receipt of your official order.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 5 days. With overtime we can deliver in 5 days, at a premium.
